newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Hennes & Mauritz soars 12 pct on 9mnth data.
newsitem.headline: Hennes & Mauritz soars 12 pct on 9mnth data.

text.p: Shares in Swedish clothing retailer Hennes & Mauritz soared after the company released results for the first nine months of the financial year that were far higher than market expectations.
At 1305 GMT, the share price stood at 760 crowns up 83 crowns or 12 percent on Wednesday's close.
Hennes & Mauritz posted a nine month pre-tax profit of 1.02 billion crowns, compared with market consensus forecasts of 853 million crowns.
